raw_text: Fact Check: Viral video of IAF pilot criticising government is a deepfake. A video purportedly showing an Indian Air Force pilot making anti-government statements has been shared widely on social media platforms, particularly on accounts linked to Pakistani state media. Alt News analysis confirms this video is AI-generated. Key findings: The facial movements are inconsistent with natural speech patterns. The uniform insignia does not match current IAF standards. The background was taken from a 2019 Air Force Day press conference. Metadata analysis reveals the video was created using commercially available deepfake software. The first instance of this video was traced to an account previously flagged for sharing ISPR-aligned content.
